findings.issue: Ghost initialization overwrote raw-populated and explicitly-unset slots, losing reference sources and object owners.
findings.repair: initializeProperties skips nonLazy location keys; ordinary new-object defaults remain unchanged.

findings.issue: Value kind cannot determine per-property lazy state.
findings.repair: Explicit raw adapter marks sparse storage-key metadata before coercion. Ordinary proxy factory writes leave flags lazy. Raw type failure restores only still-undefined originally lazy slots, matching fixed Reflection code.

findings.issue: Raw-realized proxy retained proxy identity, breaking clone and use as another factory target.
findings.repair: Commit initialize=nil,proxy=false and detached initializer before release. Last-slot initializer destructor observes completed state.

findings.issue: Factory-running raw clear flags without decrementing native remaining count.
findings.repair: Separate remaining counter from flags; decrement once only for originally-lazy, still-non-lazy, pending and not-running raw operation. Never infer remaining from map size.

findings.issue: Holding mutable reference container did not protect the actual receiver during RHS Stringable rebinding.
findings.repair: Capture and hold dereferenced receiver and RHS. Preserve receiver-then-RHS count acquisition and RHS-then-receiver cleanup. Single stack holds replace an escaping fixed slice.

findings.issue: First name match selected ancestor private slot while write used effective child descriptor.
findings.repair: Use resolved propertyInfo.key in shared isLazyPropertyInfo. By-name query resolves effective descriptor. Public/private child tests verify repeated raw assignment does not double-decrement and parent default remains pending.

architecture.selected: Sparse nonLazy map and remaining count live only on each lazy object. Keys identify storage positions, never PHP value payloads. Existing property table/value/reference layouts are unchanged. Raw slot writes share existing physical coercion/readonly/owner/typed-reference implementation through writeObjectSlot.
rejected: Value padding flags: values are copied/rebound independently of locations; preserving slot metadata would require changing common assignment/reference/copy protocols.
Inferring flags from populated values: contradicted by proxy factory writes.
Deriving remaining from flags or scanning every slot for completion: contradicted by running-proxy raw failure; repeated completion scans also add avoidable work.

Dense bitset was considered but adds index/overflow handling; its benefit for this sparse private adapter has not been measured, so no superiority is claimed for either representation outside measured cases.
Cloning nonLazy map and using a slice of holds: semantics pass but measured extra allocations have no benefit.
no_extra_cost_improvements: Shared isLazyPropertyInfo uses already-resolved descriptor, eliminating a second name scan and wrong private-slot identity.
Remaining counter replaces per-completion schema scan; this statement concerns completion bookkeeping, not the whole existing name resolver.

Running ghost cannot mutate nonLazy map: only wasLazy producer writes, and running ghost always reports false. Snapshot shares original map without clone; cleanup nils rather than clears it. Raw-inside-initializer throw/retry guards the invariant.
Single methodHold values stay on stack; constructor-style temporaries and existing-owner cleanup order are preserved.
